products.name: Findr
products.title: Findr - Social Discovery Platform
products.shortDesc: A modern social discovery platform that helps users find meaningful connections and explore social activities.
products.longDesc: Findr is an innovative social discovery platform with an intuitive interface designed to help users discover compatible profiles and coordinate social activities. The platform emphasizes genuine connections and seamless user experience.

products.name: ToolHub
products.title: ToolHub - Developer Tools & Utilities Collection
products.shortDesc: An open-source collection of developer-friendly tools and utilities designed to streamline common development tasks.
products.longDesc: ToolHub is a comprehensive collection of open-source developer tools and utilities built with a clean, accessible interface. Perfect for developers looking for quick, reliable, and reusable tools to accelerate their workflow.

products.name: TestLoop
products.title: TestLoop - Closed Testing Platform
products.shortDesc: A comprehensive platform for managing closed beta testing and QA cycles with real-time feedback collection.
products.longDesc: TestLoop enables seamless collaboration between developers and testers with an intuitive interface for bug tracking, feedback collection, and test cycle management. Designed to accelerate QA workflows and improve product quality.

products.name: DotX Widgets Pro
products.title: DotX Widgets Pro - Customizable Widget Library
products.shortDesc: A premium widget collection offering beautiful, customizable components for Android applications.
products.longDesc: DotX Widgets Pro provides developers with production-ready, customizable widget components following Material Design 3 standards. Designed to accelerate Android UI development with high-quality, reusable components.

research_engineering.name: Self-Healing Digital Twin
research_engineering.title: Self-Healing Digital Twin - Monocular 3D Perception for Autonomous Vehicles
research_engineering.shortDesc: Cutting-edge research on autonomous vehicle perception systems using monocular 3D object detection with adaptive error correction.
research_engineering.longDesc: A comprehensive research project implementing monocular 3D perception systems for autonomous vehicles. Features self-healing mechanisms for error correction and robust localization in dynamic environments.

research_engineering.name: SatRoute
research_engineering.title: SatRoute - GraphSAGE-Based Approximation of Oracle Contact-Graph Routing
research_engineering.shortDesc: Advanced satellite network routing optimization using Graph Neural Networks in collaboration with ISRO.
research_engineering.longDesc: Implements GraphSAGE-based routing algorithms for inter-satellite communication networks. Developed in collaboration with ISRO to optimize communication efficiency in satellite constellations.

research_engineering.name: Aadhaar Exclusion Mapping
research_engineering.title: Aadhaar Exclusion Mapping - Data-Driven Mobile Enrollment Strategy
research_engineering.shortDesc: Geospatial analysis of Aadhaar exclusion zones with data-driven mobile enrollment strategies for underserved communities.
research_engineering.longDesc: A comprehensive data analytics project analyzing Aadhaar digital identity exclusion zones and proposing targeted mobile enrollment strategies. Leverages geospatial analysis and demographic data to bridge the digital divide.

research_engineering.name: Leukemia Cell Classification with EfficientNetV2
research_engineering.title: Leukemia Cell Classification - Enhanced EfficientNetV2 vs Traditional CNNs
research_engineering.shortDesc: Medical AI research comparing EfficientNetV2 with traditional CNN architectures for automated leukemia cell classification.
research_engineering.longDesc: Comprehensive research project focused on medical image analysis for leukemia cell classification. Compares state-of-the-art EfficientNetV2 with traditional CNN architectures to improve diagnostic accuracy and computational efficiency.

research_concepts.name: India's Consumption Economy 2030
research_concepts.title: India's Consumption Economy 2030 - Home and Household Consumption Analysis
research_concepts.shortDesc: Comprehensive research analyzing India's household consumption trends projected to 2030. Selected among top 7 papers for final presentation.
research_concepts.longDesc: In-depth research paper analyzing India's home and household consumption patterns with projections through 2030. Selected among the top 7 research papers for final on-campus presentation at a national-level competition.
research_concepts.competition: Synthesis 2026, N. L. Dalmia Institute of Management Studies & Research

research_concepts.name: Distributed Strike-Register Sync
research_concepts.title: Distributed Strike-Register Desynchronization (DSRD) - TLS Protocol Enhancement
research_concepts.shortDesc: Cryptographic research addressing distributed strike-register synchronization in TLS protocols for improved security.
research_concepts.longDesc: Advanced cryptographic research focusing on distributed strike-register desynchronization mechanisms in TLS protocols. Explores innovative approaches to enhance security and performance in distributed systems with synchronized state management.

research_concepts.name: SchemaSetu
research_concepts.title: SchemaSetu - AI Powered Welfare Access Platform
research_concepts.shortDesc: AI-powered platform making government welfare schemes accessible and understandable to citizens using NLP.
research_concepts.longDesc: An innovative AI-powered platform designed to democratize access to government welfare schemes. Uses advanced natural language processing and machine learning to guide users through complex bureaucratic processes seamlessly.

previously_shipped.name: VIT Verse
previously_shipped.title: VIT Verse - Campus Community Platform
previously_shipped.shortDesc: Campus social network platform that served VIT university community with 7,000+ active users.
previously_shipped.longDesc: A comprehensive social networking platform designed for VIT university students. Successfully facilitated campus-wide communication, event discovery, and community engagement before being discontinued.
